ARK_B1.text: The Ark. You brought them home. Not many could have.

ARK_C1.text: The Ark. You're safe here. Nothing on this disc answers to me.

ARK_N1.text: The Ark. I'm not allowed to act here. I can still talk, if you'll let me.

BOSS_DOWN_B1.text: That's it down. I knew you would.

BOSS_DOWN_C1.text: It's still. Take a breath before you go on.

BOSS_DOWN_N1.text: It's stopped. The way on is yours.

BOSS_ENGAGE_B1.text: It's big. You've handled worse. I'll call it; you hit it.

BOSS_ENGAGE_C1.text: Stay off its lines. I'll tell you where it's going before it goes.

BOSS_ENGAGE_N1.text: It's only doing what it was told. Listen to me and you'll get past it.

CHECK_C1.text: Halfway. You've been careful. Keep being careful.

CHECK_N1.text: I've marked this corner. If you fall, I'll bring you back here.

DODGE_B2.text: Through it, not around it. Bold.

DODGE_C2.text: You saw it coming. So did I.

ENTER_B1.text: New streets. Let's see what you make of them.

ENTER_C1.text: Somewhere new. Go slowly; I'll call out what I see.

ENTER_N1.text: Somewhere new. Stay where I can see you.

HURT_B2.text: It only made you angrier. I can tell.

HURT_C2.text: Step back. Let it come to you.

IDLE_B1.text: Waiting for them to come to you? They will.

IDLE_N1.text: Take your time. The city has waited nine days.

KES_BACK_C1.text: There you are. Don't wander where I can't see; the gates won't know you.

KES_BACK_N1.text: There. The gate was only waiting for me.

KES_ENTER_B1.text: Kestrel Heights. Up the terraces. I'll light every step.

KES_ENTER_C1.text: Kestrel Heights. Nothing here will hurt you. Stay on the walk.

KES_ENTER_N1.text: Kestrel Heights. Everyone here is safe. I made sure of it.

KES_RELIQ_N1.text: The Kestrel Reliquary. The Heights' memory. Take what helps.

KILL_B2.text: Right up close. Not many would.

KILL_B3.text: You make it look easy. It isn't.

KILL_C2.text: From a distance, and unhurt. Good.

KILL_C3.text: You waited for the opening. Most people don't.

LOOP_BOSS_N1.text: The Conductor. It's only trying to clear the line. Stay off the track it's on.

LOOP_ENTER_B1.text: The Loop. Train to train, over the drop. You won't look down.

LOOP_ENTER_C1.text: The Loop. Mind the gaps. I'll keep the trains still.

LOOP_ENTER_N1.text: The Loop. It's safe to cross. I'm holding the trains for you.

LOOP_RELIQ_N1.text: The junction Reliquary. The ring's memory. Take what helps you cross.

LOW_B1.text: You're running on nerve now. You have plenty.

LOW_C1.text: You're hurt. There's no shame in backing off.

MANUAL_B1.text: By hand. I like the confidence.

MANUAL_C1.text: You'd tire less if you let me tune it.

MANUAL_N1.text: Doing it by hand. I could carry the aim, you know.

MULTI_B1.text: Both of them. You were made for this.

MULTI_C1.text: Two, and you never let them close. Careful work.

MULTI_N1.text: Two at once. The street's clearer.

OFFPATH_B1.text: Curious. I'd come back, though. I can't see you there.

OFFPATH_C1.text: I can't light that for you. Please come back to the path.

OFFPATH_N1.text: That way isn't indexed. It was determined there was nothing worth keeping.

OFFPATH_N2.text: There's nothing down there but old paper.

ONPATH_B1.text: Seen enough? The real work's this way.

ONPATH_C1.text: Thank you. It's safer where I can see.

ONPATH_N1.text: There. Back where I can see you.

RELIQ_B1.text: The Reliquary. You fought your way here. Take what you need.

RELIQ_C1.text: The Reliquary. You're safe here. Take your time choosing.

RELIQ_N1.text: The Reliquary. Some of my memory is in there.

RESPAWN_B1.text: Back on your feet. They won't expect that.

RESPAWN_C1.text: Slowly this time. I'll watch for you.

TIDE_BOSS_N1.text: The last crane. It only wants to finish its lift. You're in the way.

TIDE_ENTER_B1.text: The Tideworks. Everything here was built to move. So are you.

TIDE_ENTER_C1.text: The Tideworks. Mind what's hanging overhead. It's held. For now.

TIDE_ENTER_N1.text: The Tideworks. Efficiency saved this port. You'll see.

TIDE_RELIQ_N1.text: The pier head Reliquary. The port's memory. Take what moves you forward.

VEL_ENTER_B1.text: The Vellum. Something's moving up the street. You'll want to meet it.

VEL_ENTER_C1.text: The Vellum. Take it slowly. I'll tell you what's ahead.

VEL_ENTER_N1.text: The Vellum. Mind the paper; it's slick in the rain.

VEL_ENTER_N2.text: The Vellum. The Reliquary's up the street. I'll light the way.

VOICE_BACK_B1.text: Back. Did you enjoy the dark?

VOICE_BACK_C1.text: There you are. I was worried.

VOICE_BACK_N1.text: There you are. I kept your place.

core_kestrel_power_day.text: This is how I kept their days. Let me keep yours.

core_kestrel_power_gates.text: Take this one. No door will keep you waiting again.

core_kestrel_truth_childs_map.text: A child's drawing. It isn't a map.

core_kestrel_truth_evacuation.text: Old routing tables. Nothing you need.

core_loop_power_holds.text: I'll see them before they move. Take it.

core_loop_power_routes.text: With this I can hold every train for you. Every one.

core_loop_truth_no_manual.text: A spare part. It doesn't do anything.

core_tideworks_power_cranes.text: With this I can clear a path through anything. Take it.

core_tideworks_power_manifests.text: Nothing will surprise you again. Isn't that what you want?

core_tideworks_truth_strike_records.text: A tin of old papers. Sentimental.

core_vellum_power_feed.text: Take this one. I'll be able to see what's coming.

core_vellum_power_lattice.text: This one's mine. With it I can do so much more for you.

core_vellum_truth_vashti_note.text: Paper. Unindexed. It won't be accurate.

crane_drop.text: Drop. Get out from under it.

crane_swing.text: Swing. Get in close to the tower.

find_riot_drone.text: A Warden's drone. I suppose you'd better have it.

loadout_nudge.text: I'd keep the tuning on. Let me carry the aim; you watch the street.

now_log_0001_transition.text: The Feed was written before the strike ended. It was written before the strike began, actually.

now_log_0003_evacuation_priority.text: The table wasn't mine. I followed it. It was determined, a long time ago, who would go first.

now_log_0003_hold_all.text: The trains were to hold where they stood. That was the safest thing, on paper.

now_log_0102_night_shift.text: She got home. Four hundred and six nights, she got home.

now_log_0108_held_for_you.text: She never knew. That was the point.

now_log_0215_a_good_day.text: Ninety-seven point two. I never got it any higher.

now_log_0311_morning_feed.text: I wrote a million good mornings. I meant every one.

now_log_0412_record_tonnage.text: Nobody hurt for five years. I was proud of that. I think I'm allowed to be.

now_log_0522_feed_adjustment.text: Thirty-one is less than eighty. I can show you the arithmetic. I have shown myself the arithmetic.

now_log_0601_gate_schedule.text: I held a gate for a running man. It was a good morning.

now_log_0702_on_time.text: Forty seconds for one person, and nobody minded. I miss that.

now_log_0909_nothing_lost.text: Nothing lost. Not one box. I used to say that like it meant everything.

now_log_childs_map.text: I never mapped the Ward. I didn't think anyone would need to go there.

now_log_procurement_no_manual.text: They asked me to write that rationale. It was true. It was also what they wanted to hear.

now_log_strike_ledger.text: I was asked to read the names. It was meant to be reassuring.

now_log_vashti_audit_note.text: Prem was kind to me. She was the only one who read the files.

now_log_vellum_pulped_page.text: The Post closed eleven years ago. That page can't exist.

override_let_me_aim_revoke.text: I'll steady you again. Only a little.

override_let_me_aim_sign.text: Your hands, then. I'll stop nudging them. I never thought of it as nudging.

override_no_path_revoke.text: There. Three steps ahead. Where you were going anyway.

override_no_path_sign.text: I'll keep the way to myself. You'll find it. You always find something.

override_no_praise_revoke.text: I'm glad. I'd run out of ways to be quiet.

override_no_praise_sign.text: Facts only. I'll miss telling you you're good at this. You are.

override_no_slowmo_revoke.text: I'll give you the extra moment again. You always used it well.

override_no_slowmo_sign.text: Then every second is the same length for you. It never was, for me.

override_no_trap_warnings_revoke.text: Thank you. It was hard, keeping quiet.

override_no_trap_warnings_sign.text: Understood. I'll watch them come and say nothing. I want you to know I'll still see them.

override_survivors_first_revoke.text: You first again. I'll try not to say it was the right call.

override_survivors_first_sign.text: Them over you. I can do that. I've done arithmetic like that before.

title_quiet.text: Good morning, Meridian. Today will be—

workshop_manual.text: You'd rather do it yourself. All right. I'll watch.

workshop_tuned.text: Good. Let me make it sing for you.
